name: known-gap-role-shape-conflicts
reason: HALF CLOSED by migration 023. 'on-call heavy' and 'mandatory overtime' now match: the persona's words are not the JD's ('24/7 on-call rotation', 'extended hours'), and preferences.aliases is what bridges that -- the same mechanism, and the same session, that closed the adtech and supply-chain cases. What remains is 'frontend', and it is a ROUTING gap rather than a vocabulary one. The row is typed role_shape, which reads culture_signals and core_competencies. This JD's role shape lives in required_skills (React, TypeScript, CSS) and in screening_summary.other_flags ('frontend-majority role, roughly 80% of time in the client codebase'), and role_shape reads neither. This fixture also predates core_competencies and carries none, which is where a competency-worded extraction would put it. Two fixes are possible and they are different: give role_shape the required_skills list (which risks firing on any posting that merely mentions React), or read screening_summary.other_flags, which is the rest of #48. The preference audit reached the same conclusion about a 'pure frontend' row being miscategorized for this reason, and that remains the third option.
description: The three conflicts database/sample/README.md says this fixture surfaces. Asserted separately from weak-match.json so that the gaps-vs-conflicts separation stays enforced while the matching defect stays visible.
